sentences.text: Sk. Habibur Rahamn vs Unknown on 19 May, 2023

Author: Bibek Chaudhuri
Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
19.05.2023 Srimanta Crr/1932/2023

In the matter of : Sk. Habibur Rahamn Mr. Ayan
Bhattacherjee, Md. Zohaib Rauf ...for the petitioner.

The petitioner has approached this Court for quashing of a criminal proceeding in respect of Bagnan Police Station Case No. 195/2023 dated 15 th May, 2023 under Sections 420/406/341/323/307/506 of the Indian Penal Code pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Uluberia.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Uluberia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that in course of commercial transaction some money was paid by the opposite parties to the petitioner.
The petitioner failed to pay such amount.
In a commercial transaction if a party fails to pay money to another it does not create an offence under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
Moreover, in the discharge report of the petitioner it is found that he was hospitalized on 3rd May, 2023 and he was discharged on 6 th May, 2023.

Therefore, it is not at all possible for him to assail or to commit any offence whatsoever on 4th May,
2023.
Considering such circumstances, the instant revision is admitted.
Petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the opposite party no. 2 under registered speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service within two weeks after vacation.
State of West Bengal be served through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta.
In the meantime, the Investigation Officer shall not take any coercive step against the petitioner.
Plain copy of this order duly countersigned by the Assistant Court Officer be supplied to the learned Advocate for the petitioner.
